title_zh: 完成自助机读卡并转到柜台核验补卡

scenario.label_zh: 处理图书馆自助机的补卡限制
scenario.goal_zh: 协助读者读取旧卡并查明补卡需柜台核验，指明携带身份证明前往的地点

context_zh: 图书馆读者想用自助机更换破损借书卡，工作人员提供帮助。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: Sorry if I sound impatient. I've tried this three times, and the machine keeps sending me back.

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Let's start with the blue icon showing a card. Touch that once.

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: Now it says to insert the old card. Like this?

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Yes. It's read the number, so we know the card still works.

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: Can I get an instant replacement here? The edge is cracked.

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Not from this machine. The desk staff need to check your photo ID before issuing a new one.

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: I have my driving licence with me. Is that the desk by the stairs?

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: That's right. Take your old card with you, and they'll explain the replacement process.

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: Thanks. At least I know why the machine wouldn't finish it.

targets.sense_zh: 因等待或受阻而不耐烦的
屏幕上代表功能的小图标
